newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 35.203 bln levs 1-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 35.203 bln levs 1-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Wednesday sold a one-week discount T-bill issue, yielding 3.76 percent to maturity, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 62.353 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 35.203 billion levs worth of paper.
Each day the ministry offers one-week and four-week discount t-bills with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Bids for 44.574 billion levs were placed for the four-week t-bills on Wednesday but the ministry has not approved any.
